# Academic Timetable Generator

The Academic Timetable Generator is a web application that parses university timetable spreadsheets (Excel format .xlsx and .xls) and generates interactive, conflict-free visual weekly schedules. Users can filter courses by section, add custom/additional electives, customize color codes, resolve schedule overlaps, and export finalized timetables as high-resolution images or shareable links. All data processing occurs locally within the browser.

## Key Links & Features
